description: The design of Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Fold 8 Ultra has leaked again through dummies. The renders offer a side-by-side look at the upcoming foldables. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 has a dual camera unit, while the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra boasts a triple camera setup. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is shorter and wider and looks more like a tablet in the fully opened state. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra appears to retain the tall shape of the Galaxy Z Fold 7.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Could Feature Vastly Different Designs, Leaked Dummy Units Suggest

description: Nothing Ear 3a and CMF Buds Neo have appeared on certification platforms, suggesting that both earbuds could launch soon. The Nothing Ear 3a was spotted on Indonesia's SDPPI database, while the CMF Buds Neo appeared on both SDPPI and India's BIS platform. The listings reveal model numbers but do not disclose specifications. The BIS filing also points to local manufacturing through Optiemus Electronics Limited in Noida. The Ear 3a is expected to follow the Nothing Ear (a), which launched in April 2024.
title: Nothing Ear 3a, CMF Buds Neo Spotted on Regulatory Databases Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: Vivo Y500 surfaced on the Bluetooth SIG database with model numbers V2627, V2634, and V2635. This suggests that Vivo is gearing up to launch the phone in markets outside China. The Vivo Y500 was launched in China last year with a 6.77-inch full HD+ (2,392 x 1,080 pixels) AMOLED screen and a 4nm MediaTek Dimensity 7300 SoC. It packs up to 12GB LPDDR4X RAM and up to 512GB UFS 3.1 onboard storage.
title: Vivo Y500 Surfaces on Bluetooth SIG Database With Multiple Model Numbers, Could Launch Soon

description: Hisense has launched the U7SE 144Hz ULED Mini-LED TV series in India. Available in 55-inch, 65-inch, 75-inch, 85-inch, and 100-inch sizes, the lineup starts at Rs. 63,990. The televisions feature Mini-LED panels with Full Array Local Dimming, support for Dolby Vision IQ and HDR10+ Adaptive, and AI-powered picture optimisation through the Hi-View AI Engine. Gaming features include up to a 165Hz refresh rate, HDMI 2.1, VRR, and AMD FreeSync Premium. The series also runs on VIDAA Smart OS.
title: Hisense U7SE 144Hz ULED Mini-LED TV Series With Up to 100-Inch Screens Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Computex 2026 kicked off on Tuesday. Held in Taipei, Taiwan, day one of the computer trade shows opened with a flood of announcements centred around AI, creator-focused computing, gaming hardware, and next-generation PC platforms. From Nvidia's new RTX Spark AI ecosystem and Microsoft's most powerful Surface laptop yet to gaming handhelds, creator laptops, and enterprise-focused AI PCs, the first day set the tone for the rest of the Taipei-based trade show.
title: Computex 2026: Top 10 Product Launches and Announcements on Day 1

description: The Credit Information Bureau of India Limited is the agency that provides your CIBIL score, which helps banks determine whether you will be able to repay the loan or not. Awarded out of a total of 900 points, your CIBIL score will help you determine the amount of loan you are eligible for. The exact amount that can be issued will depend on the risk-taking ability of the bank you are applying to. Moreover, you can simply provide your CIBIL score to the loan agents to check how much interest you will have to pay for your loan.
title: How to Check CIBIL Score Online via Different Platforms: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Asus launched its new Ascent QN10 mini-PC on Tuesday, during the ongoing Computex 2026 event in Taipei, Taiwan. The new desktop is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon X2 Elite chipset. The tech giant claims that the new Asus Ascent QN10 is the first mini-PC to be powered by this particular processor. The Snapdragon X2 Elite chipset is generally found on laptops, including the recently launched Asus Swift Spin 14 AI. The SoC on the new Asus Ascent QN10 mini-PC features an NPU, which delivers up to 80 TOPS. The company says that the mini-PC is capable of running various AI models locally.
title: Asus Ascent QN10 Mini PC With Snapdragon X2 Elite Chipset Showcased at Computex 2026

description: MSI showcased several new gaming and productivity-focused laptops at Computex 2026 on Tuesday. The company unveiled the refreshed Katana and Venture series models, alongside the Crosshair A16 HX MLG Edition. MSI says the latest laptops cater to gamers, creators, and professionals, with configurations featuring Intel Core, Intel Core Ultra, and AMD Ryzen processors, coupled with Nvidia GeForce RTX 50-series graphics and Intel Arc GPUs.
title: MSI Showcases New Katana, Venture Laptops and Crosshair A16 HX MLG Edition at Computex 2026

description: Asus TUF 16 (2026) and ExpertBook B5 Flip G2 (2026) were launched on Tuesday during the ongoing Computex 2026 event. The new Asus TUF 16 (2026) gaming laptop is powered by up to an Intel Core i7 14650HX processor, featuring eight efficiency cores and eight performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 5.2GHz. Meanwhile, the Asus ExpertBook B5 Flip G2 (2026) is powered by up to an Intel Core 7 Series 3 processor, featuring an NPU with up to 18 TOPS, and an integrated Intel Graphics chip.
title: Asus TUF 16 (2026) Gaming Laptop Unveiled Alongside ExpertBook B5 Flip G2 (2026) at Computex 2026

description: Acer's latest TravelMate lineup includes the P6 14 AI, P2 Spin 14, X2 15, and X2 14. The new models feature OLED and IPS display options, Intel Core Ultra Series 3 and Core Series 3 processors, up to 64GB RAM, Wi-Fi 7 connectivity on select variants, and battery life of up to 30 hours. The P2 Spin 14 adds a convertible design with stylus support, while the X2 series focuses on business productivity and security features.
title: Acer TravelMate P6 14 AI and P2 Spin 14 Unveiled, Acer TravelMate X2 15 and X2 14 Tag Along

description: Sony Bravia 7II series has been launched in India. The lineup comes in 55-inch, 65-inch, 75-inch, and 85-inch screen sizes, and the larger 98-inch model will launch later. It runs on Sony's Cognitive Processor XR and features the company's in-house True RGB LED technology. The 65-inch and larger models pack X-Wide Angle Pro. It runs on Google TV and has Google Assistant support.
title: Sony Bravia 7II 4K TVs Launched in India With Cognitive Processor XR, Dolby Vision: Price, Features

description: Apple released the iOS 26.5.1 update for iPhone on Tuesday. It arrives roughly three weeks after the rollout of iOS 26.5, which introduced support for RCS end-to-end encryption, and is reportedly limited to the iPhone Air and the entire iPhone 17 lineup. As per the Cupertino-based tech giant, the latest release addresses a charging-related issue that affected a small number of iPhone 17 and iPhone Air users in recent months.
title: Apple Rolls Out iOS 26.5.1 Update With Fix for Charging Bug Affecting iPhone Air, iPhone 17 Models

description: Amazon has launched a new subscription tier in India for its Amazon Music platform. Now, it will serve as the only subscription plan in the country. However, the US-based tech giant plans to launch a new free tier for users in the country, which will play ads for users, similar to Spotify’s free access. While access to Amazon Music will remain included in the Amazon Prime membership, the app will start playing “limited ads” for subscribers starting July 2. With this, the company appears to be following the same strategy as it did for the Prime Video platform, which asks Prime members to pay more for an ad-free experience.
title: Amazon Music to Play ‘Limited Ads’ for Prime Members in India as Firm Offers Unlimited Plan With Ad-Free Music Streaming

description: Asus has unveiled the Asus Pad at Computex 2026, marking its return to the Android tablet market. The tablet features a 12.2-inch 2.8K dual-layer OLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate, a MediaTek Dimensity 8300 chipset, and a 9,000mAh battery with 45W charging support. It runs on Android 16 and includes Google Gemini, Circle to Search, and Asus GlideX features. The tablet also offers Dolby Atmos-backed quad speakers, expandable storage up to 1TB, and support for the Asus Pen 2.0.
title: Asus Pad With MediaTek Dimensity 8300 Chip, 9,000mAh Battery Unveiled at Computex 2026

description: Asus Zenbook 14, Vivobook S14, Vivobook S16, Vivobook S14 Flip, and Vivobook S16 Flip laptops have been launched during Computex 2026. The Asus Zenbook 14 comes in Intel, AMD or Snapdragon CPU options. The Vivobook S series runs on Snapdragon chipsets. The Vivobook S14 Flip and Vivobook S16 Flip feature a 360-degree hinge. Asus has yet to reveal the pricing and availability details of the new models.
title: Asus Zenbook 14, Vivobook S14, Vivobook S16, Vivobook S14 Flip and Vivobook S16 Flip Launched at Computex 2026

description: Xiaomi announced the availability of AirDrop support over Quick Share for Xiaomi 17T Pro. The company posted a video on X, and it demonstrates AirDrop file transfers on the Xiaomi 17T Pro with an iPhone model. The company has yet to reveal when the feature will be rolled out to other Xiaomi smartphones. It is expected to gradually reach more smartphones running on HyperOS 3.
title: Xiaomi's HyperOS 3 Adds AirDrop Support on Select Models With Ability to Share Files With Apple Devices

description: Apple may launch the iPhone 18 Pro with different battery capacities depending on the market, according to a new leak. Physical SIM variants could feature a 4,056mAh battery, while eSIM-only models may get a larger 4,288mAh cell. The phone is also expected to feature Apple's 2nm A20 Pro chip and a variable-aperture 48-megapixel main camera. The upgrades could raise production costs, although Apple may absorb some of the increase instead of raising prices.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Leak Hints at Two Battery Variants With Slightly Different Capacities

description: Apple has shared a poster for the WWDC 2026, which shows a glowing Apple logo with a white beam of light moving inwards. The teaser was posted with the tagline “All systems glow for a great WWDC 26 next week.” Separately, a new wallpaper with the tagline, “Glow all out,” is now available on Apple’s website for Mac, iPhone, and iPad models. The new wallpaper has the same aesthetics and colour scheme as the promo shared by the company executive, which shows a glowing Apple logo. However, it only displays the top half of the company branding. Lastly, the tech giant has created a new Apple Music playlist, titled “WWDC26 Hello”.
title: Apple Releases New ‘Glow All Out’ Wallpaper, Apple Music Playlist Hinting at Next Week’s WWDC 2026 Theme

description: MSI Prestige N16 Flip AI+ was announced at Computex 2026 on Tuesday. It is the company’s first laptop developed in collaboration with Nvidia and powered by the new RTX Spark platform. The Taiwanese PC maker has positioned the laptop as a next-generation AI PC that combines Nvidia's full-stack AI platform, RTX technologies, and a 2-in-1 design. The MSI Prestige N16 Flip AI+ sports a 16-inch Ultra HD+ Tandem OLED screen.
title: Computex 2026: MSI Prestige N16 Flip AI+ Announced as Company's First Nvidia RTX Spark-Powered Laptop

description: Asus has unveiled the ProArt P16 and ProArt P14 laptops alongside the new ProArt Mini PC at Computex 2026. Powered by Nvidia RTX Spark, the devices support up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of AI performance. The laptops feature Asus Lumina Pro OLED displays, batteries up to 99.9Wh, and AI-focused software tools. The ProArt Mini PC offers a compact design with 10GbE networking and PCIe Gen 5 expansion. Availability is set for fall 2026.
title: Asus ProArt P16, ProArt P14 and New ProArt Mini PC With Nvidia RTX Spark Unveiled at Computex 2026

description: ViewSonic IN05 Series ViewBoard 4K EDLA interactive displays have been launched in India. The lineup includes 65-inch (IN6505-N), 75-inch (N7505-N) and 86-inch (IN8605-N) models, and they are designed for classroom and learning purposes. They run on Android 16 and feature 8GB RAM and 128GB onboard storage. The display has dual speakers with 20W audio output.
title: ViewSonic IN05 Series ViewBoard 4K Displays Launched in India With Android 16, AI Features

description: Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 bundle was launched on Monday during the Computex 2026. The console boasts a “translucent black chassis” and gold design graphics, with a golden backlight for the light and right joysticks. Inside the box, the tech giant will include the Asus ROG XReal R1 Edition 20 AR smartglasses, along with the Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 console. In terms of specifications, the special edition gaming handheld gets almost the same hardware as the standard model. The X20 model sports a 7.4-inch Full-HD (1,920 x 1,080 pixels) OLED touchscreen, with up to 1,400 nits peak brightness, up to 120Hz of refresh rate, 100 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut, Gorilla Glass Victus protection, and Dolby Vision. Meanwhile, the standard edition boasts a slightly smaller 7-inch OLED display.
title: Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 With Larger 7.4-Inch OLED Display Unveiled at Computex 2026

description: The Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 was launched in 2024, and its successor could be on the cards soon. It was previously believed that the South Korean tech conglomerate could announce the purported wearable, widely known as the Galaxy Fit 4, alongside its next-generation foldables and smartwatches in July/August. However, a recent report suggests that the Galaxy Fit 4 is reportedly not part of those plans. Instead, the wearable could arrive later this year alongside other Galaxy devices.
title: Samsung Galaxy Fit 4 Launch Timeline Reportedly Leaked; May Debut Alongside Galaxy S26 FE

description: Apple’s first-ever foldable iPhone is expected to launch later this year alongside the iPhone 18 Pro lineup. While the company has yet to confirm the purported handset, the rumour mill, in recent weeks, has suggested that it could debut as the iPhone Ultra. A tipster has now shared details about a possible colourway of the wide-foldable. Meanwhile, another tipster claims the iPhone Ultra could feature a vapour chamber system for upgraded thermal management.
title: iPhone Ultra Tipped to Launch in White Colourway; May Feature Vapour Chamber Cooling

description: The Moto G37 Power was recently launched in India alongside the standard Moto G37 model. It currently retails in the country at a starting price of Rs. 15,999 for the base 4GB RAM model. The new smartphone boasts a 7,000mAh battery. In real-world use, it offers a really long battery life, which is more than enough even for casual users. Adding to this, the standby battery drain is minimal. However, the lack of an ultrawide camera, which is found on its predecessor, is slightly disappointing. But the primary rear camera remains the same, which means you can still capture decent photos and videos in most scenarios.
title: Moto G37 Power Review: Covers All the Bases and More
